By the reflection, the equal-area condition gives
\[
4a+b=1.
\]
Then by Cauchy,
\[
(4a+b)\left(\frac1{2a}+\frac2b\right)
\ge \left(\sqrt{4a\cdot \frac1{2a}}+\sqrt{b\cdot \frac2b}\right)^2
=(\sqrt2+\sqrt2)^2=8.
\]
Since \(4a+b=1\),
\[
\frac1{2a}+\frac2b \ge 8.
\]
Equality occurs at \(b=4a\), giving \(a=\frac18,\ b=\frac12\).

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
